channel.title: imisofts Newsdesk
channel.description: News for outbound sales teams: rule changes, platform changes and price changes, reported from the primary source.

item.title: FCC Call Blocking Proposal: Many Carriers Would Have to Block
item.description: FCC Chairman Carr proposed on Nov 23 that many carriers be required to block calls highly likely to be illegal. Today's rule only allows it. Vote on Dec 17.

item.title: Claude Opus 4.5 Retirement: API Calls Fail From January 22, 2027
item.description: Anthropic retires Claude Opus 4.5 on the Claude API on Jan 22, 2027. Opus 5.5 is 20% cheaper per token but may count up to 35% more tokens. What breaks.

item.title: OpenAI Adds 2h and 8h Background Windows at 30% and 40% Off
item.description: OpenAI added 2-hour and 8-hour background windows in public beta on four models, at 30% and 40% below Standard token rates. What qualifies and what agents save.

item.title: Twilio Lists 22 A2P 10DLC Rejection Codes for December 9
item.description: Twilio plans to introduce more specific A2P 10DLC campaign rejection codes on December 9, 2026. The 22 codes it lists, in three groups, and what to check now.

item.title: Google Search Referrer Values: Two Patterns to Match
item.description: Google's new Search page, added Nov 12, lists the Referer values Search sends: google.com or a local Google domain, and one Android app string. How to match.
